test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a partnership firm two partners, Vijay and Praveen are working on an assignment. It will take 12 weeks for Vijay to complete the entire assignment alone, while Praveen will take 8 weeks to complete it alone. Due to work pressure, they decided to work on that assignment on the alternate week basis. In the first week Praveen will work and in the second week Vijay will work and so on. In how many weeks the work will be completed if they work on alternate week basis?
solution:
Given:

Vijay complete the work in 12 weeks

Praveen complete the work in 8 weeks

They work on alternate weeks starting with Praveen 

Formula used:

Total work = Efficiency timesTime taken

Calculations:

⇒ Total work = LCM of 12 and 8 = 24

⇒ Efficiency of Vijay = Work / Time = 24 / 12 = 2

⇒ Efficiency of Praveen = 24 / 8 = 3

As they work on the alternative basis

⇒ 1 week = 3 work done

⇒ 2 week = 3 + 2 = 5 

similarly,

⇒ In 8 week = 20 work

⇒ 9 week = 20 + 3 = 23 work

Remaining work is done by Vijay

⇒ Time taken to complete = 1 / 2 = 0.5 week

⇒ Total time taken to complete the work = 9 + 0.5 = 9.5 week

**⇒ ****Hence, The work done on alternative basis will take 9.5 weeks**
